svg.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
svg.aria-label: A floating waybar of frosted pills over a desktop with a terminal, where layover wear lists every hack passing rule one: Night Mail, Frost Aurora, Signal Lamps, Starfield, Menger Vault, Quasi Lattice, Ripple Tank, Moire Loom, Julia Filigree, Prism Barrel, Helix Tunnel, Pulsar Ridge, Truchet Weave, Voronoi Glass, Apollonian Lace, Marble Vein, Flux Grid, Lava Drift, Klein Fold, Reagent Bloom, Fault Strata, Ember Plume, Spore Cloud, Crystal Reef, Flame Veil, Star Shell, Tidal Spiral, Silk Flurry, Fluid Beads, Silver Shoal, Wisp Swarm, Ribbon Trace, Cycloid Rose, Hyper Cell, Phase Knot and the Departure Board with their average level, longest lit dwell and hottest area. Layover's lamp in the bar is a dim moon. A click on it springs the drawer out: the Now tab says Armed with the idle line drawn to scale, the saver at 15m and the lock and screens off at 1h, nothing holding it, holds of 30m to 4h, and the hacks up next with Start saver now and Skip; the Hacks tab is a gallery of pictures of each hack with its family, passes, a star and a switch for the rotation, under a search box, filter chips, Measure and Audition; the History tab shows today as a strip and what the line did and why. A click outside closes it. The desk goes quiet, the clock jumps from 14:28 to 14:43, and the saver fades in over the whole screen, bar included: a dim mail train with lit windows crosses dark hills while the moon climbs across a field of drifting stars and signal lamps scroll past. It hands off through black to Signal Lamps, soft red, green, amber and frost lamps drifting out of focus. The mouse moves and the saver is gone at once. In the terminal layover hold 1h turns the lamp amber with 1h beside it, its tooltip says held by you for 1h more, and layover release turns it dim again.
